title: Shadows of Night
about: A nearly forgotten song unexpectedly unlocking an entire summer of memories.
description: This track is about hearing a familiar melody years later and suddenly being pulled back into a part of life I thought had faded. Shadows of Night brought back the ballroom, the grand staircase, the stage, the lights, and the feeling of seeing everything through younger eyes. It's about music acting as a kind of memory vault, preserving moments we may no longer be able to reach until the right song opens the door again.
lyrics: In more years than I could count.
I thought that summer had slipped away,
Until a song I'd almost forgotten
Found its way back to my ears.
Brought an entire year back to me.
Like it had never left at all.
Waiting for the lights to rise.
I wasn't watching an old performance...
I was seeing through younger eyes.
Not every memory fades the same.
You don't go looking for the past...
Sometimes the past comes looking for you.
Was more than just a song.
It carried back a piece of me
I'd thought was gone too long.
I pressed play to hear the music...
